name: Kanmaki (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Kanmaki town emblem in white: an outlined ring of concentric arcs enclosing a four-petalled flower.
history: Municipal flag of Kanmaki, a town in Nara Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Kanmaki town emblem — an outlined ring of concentric arcs enclosing a four-petalled flower
